text:
elaine: heads-up — CI perf alert after the CUDA/driver patch (12.10.1) landed in nightly. small-batch chat latency P95 up ~22% on a100 pools :grimacing:

elaine: failing job: nightly/serving-latency-smallbatch (compare against baseline from yesterday)

elaine: snippets from the smoke run:
```
baseline (driver 12.9.x): p95=48ms, p99=92ms
after 12.10.1: p95=59ms, p99=127ms
throughput same, but per-token service time jumped on short sequences
```

sanjay: ugh. any obvious kernel diff from triton autotune tables?

elaine: I grabbed the autotune table diffs from the CI artifact — matmul kernel selection for small M (tiny batch) swapped from sm80_tiled_64x64 to sm80_wide_128x32 in a bunch of cases. looks correlated with the latency regression.

marco: interesting — that wider kernel is faster at large batch but has higher startup cost + worse L2 reuse for small KV cache hits. could explain the P95.

elaine: also saw an increase in L2 read stalls in the Nsight trace around the KV lookup path. attaching short excerpt:
```
Timeline: kernel launch -> memcpy -> matmul_kernel(sm80_wide_128x32) -> sync
L2 read stall spikes at matmul entry, NVTX shows cache thrash on kv_get path
```

ci-bot: nightly/serving-latency-smallbatch failed — regression threshold 10% exceeded. CI run id: build-2026-03-16-1203 (artifact: autotune-diffs.tar.gz)

sanjay: can someone bisect whether the driver bump or the pytorch/teton bump triggered this? we landed both in the same window last night.

elaine: plan: 1) revert driver 12.10.1 for canary pools 2) repro locally with 12.10.1 + older pytorch 2.2. 3) run triton autotune compare.

marco: I can repro on a devbox with the exact docker image — pulling the CI artifact now. will try forcing the old auto-tuning table and see if latency returns to baseline.

katie: can we hold the rollout? release pipeline shows canary start in 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion for infra/driver-updates scheduled at 2026-03-16T15:00Z. To pause, react with :no_entry_sign: within 10 minutes.

sanjay: pausing rollout — @deploy-bot please halt canary.

elaine: quick triage notes:
- regression only on small-batch low latency profile (chat short sequences)
- kv cache metrics: higher eviction rate and worse read latency under same QPS
- autotune kernel switch lines up exactly with when driver libs changed (cuBLAS/cuDNN microcode behavior?)

marco: tried forcing old kernel via triton config override, p95 back to 49ms locally. looks like kernel choice is the root cause, not batching heuristics change.

elaine: great repro. next steps: capture full nvprof/Nsight trace and open a bug with Nvidia (and Triton) — include matmul PTX diffs if we can. also propose small rollback of driver on canary until we have a patch.

sanjay: I'll open the rollback PR for infra and tag @infra-oncall. also add a CI job to run small-batch autotune comparisons to catch this earlier.

katie: postmortem checklist: what caused us to land two platform changes together? need a gate for combined infra+lib bumps.

marco: adding a quick opt-in flag to force small-kernel selection for tiny batches as a short-term mitigation.

elaine: notes for bug report: attach: autotune table before/after, Nsight timeline, p95/p99 numbers, L2 cache stats, minimal repro script (runs 50 small sequences).

ci-bot: artifact uploaded: nsight-trace-1765432100.zip (link: https://ci.redwood.example/build-1765432100/artifacts/nsight-trace-1765432100.zip)

elaine: thanks — tagging @sanjay @marco @katie for follow-ups. I'll update thread after rollback outcome. :eyes: 

sanjay: confirmed rollover paused. will post PR link when created. :thumbsup: 

marco: PR for kernel-override mitigation ready: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/merge_requests/5523 — adds a tiny-batch hint to prefer tiled_64x64 for M<=64.

elaine: moving to ops: can we schedule a small canary with driver 12.9 + new triton table to verify there isn't another factor?

ops-bot: canary created: canary-a100-legacydriver (nodes: 4) — test window 2h.

elaine: recording action items: 1) infra rollback PR (sanjay) 2) kernel-override MR (marco) 3) open vendor bug + attach traces (elaine) 4) add autotune small-batch CI check (sanjay)

katie: ping me when rollback is live and we can resume the main canary.

elaine: update 20m: rollback PR merged, canary paused, running baseline repro on canary -> preliminary p95 back to 50ms. will keep the canary under observation.

sanjay: nice. reopening release hold until vendor response and a proper root-cause fix.

marco: will follow up with a small benchmark script and instructions for reproducing the kernel choice so other engs can validate on different HW.

elaine: thanks all — threading this into the incident board. :white_check_mark:
